brain_intelligence_guidelines.title: Domain K — Quality & Verification: Zero-Outbound Network Probe & Assertion Barrier
brain_intelligence_guidelines.invariant: Verification suites for client-side privacy tools must execute live network inspection probes during transformation workflows. Any outgoing HTTP POST, PUT, or WebSocket connection emitted during file processing constitutes an automatic fatal verification failure.

brain_intelligence_guidelines.title: Severed CFG Edge Phi Node Invariant Failure in React Compiler (BUG-OXC-01)
brain_intelligence_guidelines.invariant: Conflating basic block existence with edge existence. A block can remain in the CFG while a specific outgoing branch is eliminated. -> SSA and CFG mutations must always be parameterized by the local incidence matrix (predecessors/successors), never by global vertex sets.

brain_intelligence_guidelines.title: Type Stripping Regression in Exported Ambient Declarations (BUG-OXC-02)
brain_intelligence_guidelines.invariant: Bypassing semantic graph traversal during optimization or "no-op" bypass branches. -> Even if an AST node is copied verbatim without mutation, it must traverse the semantic symbol dependency analyzer before codegen.
